description: Source code for NextcloudAPIProvider class managing API clients with support for self-signed certificates, using Retrofit and OkHttp in an Android environment.

classes.name: NextcloudAPIProvider
classes.description: Provides configured instances of NextcloudAPI with support for default and self-signed SSL certificates, based on user preferences.

methods.name: getAPI
methods.description: Returns the appropriate NextcloudAPI instance based on user preference for trusting self-signed certificates.

methods.name: createDefaultClient
methods.description: Creates an OkHttpClient with basic logging and redacted headers.

methods.name: createSelfSignedTrustingClient
methods.description: Creates an OkHttpClient that trusts all SSL certificates, including self-signed ones, with logging and header redaction.

methods.name: builder
methods.description: Builds a Retrofit.Builder with base URL and JSON converter.
